title: DCSweepParserConfigV0
description: Settings needed to parsed the initial draft of the DC Sweep measurement.

settings.description: The settings file of the measurement (optional).

RF_off_time_offset_method.description: Method for determining the last time point in the averaging window. If 'max_change': look for a change in column values corresponding to the source being turned off. If 'first_data_point', pick the time when the RF source was turned off - instr_timing_tolerance.

RF_on_average_window.description: time window (in seconds) to average over when evaluating long timescale settled values.

stats_window_override.description: Override the statswindow (in seconds) to average over when evaluating long timescale RF off values.
